title: Red Faction
statusNote: The main menu, help and credits work, and a new game loads the first level (The Mines) and plays: walking, turning, sidestepping and shooting work, and the in-game menu opens.
notes: Menus are selected with the left soft key; the OK key does nothing there. The right soft key goes back.
In play either soft key opens the menu (sound, music, quit to menu).

VS (a deathmatch over Bluetooth) works between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer): one chooses Play > VS > Host, with the map and the frag limit set on that screen, the other Play > VS > Join and then the host's name with the left soft key; the match starts at once. Key 7 leaves the waiting screens.

multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chooses Play > VS > Host (with the map and frag limit), the other Join and the host's name in the list; both load the map and a deathmatch runs on both screens. The game menu one opens pauses the other's screen too, and when one quits the other reads "Connection was lost". The two did not meet in the map. Tried with Red Faction, not Blue Faction, the same program.

enhance.note: The mine, doors and effects are captured; the HUD and the gun are 2D. The game never clears its screen, so where no triangle is drawn the last picture stays.

controls.source: The game's Help, page 4 (Game Controls). Forward, turn, fire, sidestep and the menu key were confirmed in play; the menu keys were observed. The OK key did nothing in menus or in play.
notes: First-person layout: move and sidestep on WASD, turn on the arrows or Q/E. F fires or uses, Space jumps, V toggles look mode, [ and ] change weapon, Tab picks the last weapon. Enter selects in menus and Escape opens the menu or goes back. On a gamepad the left stick moves and turns, the right stick sidesteps and the right trigger fires.
